title: The Stone That Bends Light
short_teaser: Certain crystals split light into two rays, producing double images.
story: Certain crystals split light into two rays, producing double images. A solid object can alter perception in surprising ways. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective by reminding us how much remains unseen. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A solid object can alter perception in surprising ways. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective by reminding us how much remains unseen.
spark_application: Spend five quiet minutes noticing something that creates awe or surprise. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
